Bangladesh seamers made key breakthroughs during the session with the new ball. Taskin Ahmed finished with figures of 2 for 88 by dismissing Wiaan Mulder for a duck and Marco Jansen for eight, with wicketkeeper Litton Das catching both. Despite struggling with a sore elbow, Hasan Mahmud claimed 4 for 72 by removing Simon Harmer for one just before lunch, also caught by Das.

Earlier in the match, South Africa's opening batter Marques Ackerman recorded a career-best 157 runs off 164 deliveries, while number three batsman Zubayr Hamza contributed 83 runs upon returning to the lineup. Bavuma remains eligible to return and bat later in the innings if necessary.

stories.title: Pakistan Government Cuts Petrol Price by Rs3 While Keeping Diesel Unchanged
stories.summary:
The federal government of Pakistan announced a reduction in the price of petrol by Rs3 per litre, bringing the new rate to Rs325. Meanwhile, the price of high-speed diesel remained unchanged at Rs358 per litre for November 18, according to a Petroleum Division notification.

This adjustment follows a previous Rs2 reduction for November 17. Earlier measures included oil refineries absorbing costs to maintain lower prices amid global market volatility driven by the US-Israeli conflict with Iran. In July, daily price reviews replaced weekly ones due to supply concerns.

To assist lower-income consumers, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif previously launched a relief scheme offering discounted fuel for motorcycles, rickshaws, and cars under 800cc. Additionally, the government has enforced austerity and conservation measures, requiring commercial venues, markets, and shops to close at specified evening hours.

stories.title: Hailstorm and Rain Cut Short South Africa's Charge Against Bangladesh
stories.summary:
Severe hailstorm and rain halted play on the third day of the opening Test match between South Africa and Bangladesh at the Wanderers. The hosts reached 386-7 after 90 overs, trailing Bangladesh's first-innings total of 400 by 14 runs when bad weather ended the sessions.

South Africa resumed the day at 287-4, building on Marques Ackerman's overnight century of 157. Ryan Rickelton anchored the innings with an unbeaten 56 off 104 balls, while captain Temba Bavuma added 30 runs before retiring hurt with a leg muscle strain on 49. Bangladesh bowlers then claimed crucial late wickets to check the hosts' progress.

Taskin Ahmed dismissed Wiaan Mulder and Marco Jansen, and Hasan Mahmud removed Simon Harmer. Hasan finished as Bangladesh's leading bowler with 4-72, while Taskin picked up two wickets. Kagisa Rabada was not out on five alongside Rickelton when rain stopped play.

Bangladesh had earlier posted 400 runs, driven by centuries from Towhid Hridoy and Litton Das. South Africa's bowling attack in that innings was led by Rabada with five wickets and Dane Paterson with four.

stories.title: Pakistani Rupee Edges Up Slightly Against US Dollar
stories.summary:
The Pakistani rupee recorded a marginal increase against the US dollar in the inter-bank market on Tuesday. At the close of the trading day, the domestic currency finished at 276.56, marking a rise of Re0.01 compared to the previous day when it closed at 276.57.

On the international stage, the US dollar reached a new 19-month high against a basket of peer currencies on Tuesday. This movement was driven by expectations of stricter monetary policy tightening by the US Federal Reserve following recent high inflation figures and hawkish remarks from central bank officials. The greenback also extended a 10-month high against the Australian currency as a worldwide selloff in artificial intelligence stocks affected market sentiment and weakened the risk-sensitive Australian dollar.

Accelerating consumer inflation in the United States last week sparked five consecutive days of gains for the US dollar index, extending into a sixth day on Tuesday to reach 103.66, which is its highest level since April 2, 2025, when President Donald Trump introduced his tariffs. The index tracks the greenback against six major currencies, including the euro, British pound, and Japanese yen. Market participants now view a Federal Reserve interest rate increase at the December meeting as certain, with the CME Group’s FedWatch tool indicating about four percent probability for an oversized half-point hike.

Meanwhile, oil prices declined on Tuesday as anticipated supply surpluses stemming from recovering Middle East exports outweighed worries regarding ongoing tanker attacks and broader geopolitical tensions. Brent crude futures dropped by 78 cents, or 0.8 percent, to $91.66 a barrel by 0430 GMT, while US West Texas Intermediate futures fell by 73 cents, or 0.9 percent, to $84.99 a barrel.

stories.title: MS Dhoni Retires From IPL Play to Become Chennai Mentor
stories.summary:
Former India cricket captain MS Dhoni has ended his playing career in the Indian Premier League and transitioned into a mentoring position with the Chennai Super Kings, the franchise announced on Tuesday. The 45-year-old wicketkeeper-batter, who last represented India internationally in 2019, guided Chennai to five tournament titles, establishing the team as one of the most successful in the competition.

Chennai owner Rupa Gurunath praised the player in a statement, noting that his experience and expertise will prove especially valuable as the franchise works to nurture younger athletes during a transition period. Chennai finished eighth in the 10-team standings during a disappointing campaign this year, having last won the championship trophy in 2023.

Throughout his career with the franchise, Dhoni accumulated 5,314 runs, making him Chennai's second-highest run-scorer. He also holds the record for the most appearances for the team with 272 matches played. Widely known as "Captain Cool" for his calm demeanor under pressure, he earned renown for his finishing skills and ability to guide the team through challenging run chases.

On the international stage, Dhoni led India to victory in the 2007 T20 World Cup and the 2011 ODI World Cup. Although he retired from international cricket in 2020, he continued playing in the IPL, though lingering knee issues and declining batting form limited his on-field impact in recent years. Chennai managing director Kasi Viswanathan stated that while fans will miss seeing him wear yellow on the field, the franchise is pleased he will continue guiding the players. The auction for the 2027 IPL season is set for December 16 in Goa.

stories.title: Copper Hits Multi-Month Low as Technology Sector Weakness Pressures Prices
stories.summary:
Copper prices declined to their lowest level in four and a half months on Tuesday. The drop was driven by weakness in technology stocks that sparked concerns regarding artificial intelligence-related investments and dampened risk appetite, while a stronger US dollar and expectations of rising interest rates added further downward pressure.

Benchmark three-month copper on the London Metal Exchange decreased by 0.3 percent to $13,211.50 per metric ton by 0955 GMT, after touching $13,144 earlier in the session, marking its lowest price point since July 1. Asian stock markets declined following Washington's announcement that it would implement further restrictions on China's access to advanced artificial intelligence chips from companies like Nvidia, tightening regulations as President Donald Trump traveled to China for discussions with President Xi Jinping.

According to ING commodities strategist Ewa Manthey, the selloff in artificial intelligence shares has raised worries about the demand outlook for copper, given the metal's increasing exposure to investments in data centers and power grids. Despite these pressures, signs of tight prompt supply provided some backing for copper, reflected by an increase in the Yangshan copper premium—an indicator of China's demand for imported metal—and the premium of the LME cash copper contract over the benchmark.

The strengthening US dollar reached a 19-month peak on Tuesday amid expectations of aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, making dollar-priced metals more expensive for purchasers using other currencies. Meanwhile, LME aluminum dropped 1.2 percent to $2,967 after hitting a one-month low of $2,965, and the premium of the LME cash contract over the three-month contract reached $278 a ton, the highest level recorded since 1988 due to low stock levels. Other metals saw mixed results, with LME zinc losing 0.6 percent to $3,676, lead remaining stable at $1,875, nickel gaining 0.6 percent to $15,945, and tin rising 0.5 percent to $46,285.

stories.title: Pakistan HEC Announces 61 Chinese Government Scholarships for 2027–28
stories.summary:
The Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan has officially rolled out the Chinese Government Scholarship Programme for the 2027–28 academic year, opening doors for local scholars to pursue degrees at universities across China. Managed via the Chinese Scholarship Council, a total of 61 slots have been designated for Pakistani applicants seeking higher education opportunities abroad.

The distribution of these funded positions includes 25 undergraduate slots, 21 master's positions, and 15 PhD opportunities. The HEC is acting as the official nominating entity for candidates applying through the designated Type-A framework, requiring all interested parties to utilize its online portal before the cutoff time of 4:00 pm on January 5, 2027.

Authorities have stressed that only records formally updated to a "Submitted" status on the application portal will move forward in the evaluation pipeline. Drafts left unsubmitted will be automatically disqualified from consideration. Candidates opting for Type-B or alternative funding pathways must manage their paperwork and direct correspondence independently without HEC nomination.

Additionally, the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) has been declared a mandatory testing prerequisite for anyone targeting undergraduate studies within Chinese institutions. This rule applies universally across all scholarship channels, including Type-A HEC nominees and Type-B applicants alike, prompting officials to urge thorough reviews of all posted guidelines prior to submission.

stories.title: NDMA Issues Severe Drought Alert for Districts in Sindh and Balochistan
stories.summary:
The National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA), through its National Emergency Operations Centre, has sounded a high alert warning of potential severe drought emergencies spanning multiple regions in Sindh and Balochistan. Officials pointed to prolonged dry spells, below-average rainfall totals, rising temperatures, and shifting monsoon patterns as the primary drivers behind the crisis.

The areas facing the highest threats include parts of the Umerkot, Tharparkar, Mirpurkhas, and Sujawal districts in Sindh, alongside select pockets of Chagai and Washuk in Balochistan. Local weather stations have recorded temperatures running one to three degrees Celsius higher than typical seasonal averages across the endangered zones in Sindh, worsening ecological stress.

This unfolding environmental strain has severely disrupted regional agricultural operations and crop yields, sparking deep worries regarding household and regional food security. The National Emergency Operations Centre is maintaining continuous surveillance over the developing situation as ground conditions remain under close watch.

In response to the hazard, the NDMA has instructed relevant administrative bodies to optimize local water supplies and deploy preventative safeguards aimed at shielding vulnerable rural populations and farming communities. Residents have simultaneously been urged to adhere strictly to safety advisories issued by local authorities to safeguard their livestock and harvests.

stories.title: MS Dhoni Concludes Playing Career and Joins Chennai as Mentor
stories.summary:
Mahendra Singh Dhoni has formally concluded his playing career in the Indian Premier League, taking on a new role as team mentor for the Chennai Super Kings. The 45-year-old athlete, widely celebrated as a pivotal figure in the franchise's history, previously stepped away from international cricket back in the year 2020.

During his illustrious tenure on the field, Dhoni captained the Chennai squad to a remarkable five Indian Premier League trophies alongside two Champions League Twenty20 titles. Hailing from Ranchi, he maintained a profound connection with supporters in Chennai, where fans frequently packed stadiums simply to catch a glimpse of the leader affectionately known locally as "Thala."

Although recent seasons saw a decline in his batting output down the order, large crowds continued to fill the stands to watch him play. However, a persistent calf strain forced him to sit out the entirety of the most recent season, ultimately bringing his active playing days to a close. Except for two seasons with the Rising Pune Super Giant during Chennai's two-year suspension over a corruption scandal, Dhoni remained the face of the franchise from his arrival in 2008 onward.

Team owner N. Srinivasan praised Dhoni as an integral part of the franchise's identity, noting that selecting him in the 2008 draft was the best decision in the club's history. Managing director K.S. Viswanathan also expressed relief that Dhoni will remain onboard to counsel younger players, ensuring his leadership will continue to shape the team's trajectory for years to come.

stories.title: Over 8,000 Hoax Bomb Threats Disrupt European Schools and Airports
stories.summary:
More than 8,000 bomb hoaxes targeted businesses and institutions across Europe over the span of a month, according to disclosures by European officials, media reports, and cybersecurity firms like Proofpoint and Mimecast. The campaign primarily affected schools in the United Kingdom, Ireland, and Italy, while also disrupting airlines, airports, media organizations, and charities. Notable incidents included threats sent to approximately 300 schools in Northern Ireland and Scotland on October 19 with the subject line "Death is near," prompting evacuations and room searches.

The wave of disruptions continued into November, forcing dozens of flight diversions and cancellations. Flight tracking specialists AirNav Radar reported that over 50 flights across roughly 15 airlines received hoax threats between November 2 and November 6. Media outlets, such as France's TF1, Bulgaria's Nova, and Irish broadcaster RTE, were also targeted, briefly knocking some programs off the air. A significantly larger wave occurred on November 11, when about 6,300 Italian schools, along with roughly 1,000 schools in Scotland and 300 each in Northern Ireland and Ireland, received threats purportedly originating from a group called "Misoginistan" or "Male State."

European officials, including French interior minister Laurent Nuñez, have stated they suspect foreign interference, specifically pointing to Russia or other potential countries, while Europol works to determine the origin of the threats. Cybersecurity experts noted similarities in the wording and distribution methods, suggesting the use of a shared target list. School principals and authorities emphasized that despite appearing implausible or reckless, the threats had to be treated with extreme seriousness due to safety concerns.

The mass-distributed emails were sent from at least four hijacked email accounts, including one belonging to a former graduate student at Da-Yeh University in Taiwan. While previous bomb hoaxes in Western government entities had been linked by cybersecurity firms to suspected Russian mercenary hackers known as the DaVinci Group, officials continue extensive inquiries to confirm direct connections. The widespread disruptions have left communities and institutions on high alert as investigations into the source of the campaign persist.

stories.title: Massive Fire Destructs Glass Factory Following Oil Tanker Blast in Karachi
stories.summary:
A large-scale fire erupted at an industrial facility situated in Karachi’s Baldia Town on Tuesday morning, triggered during the replenishment of an underground fuel repository by an oil tanker. Rescue-1122 received initial alerts regarding the incident at approximately 10:36 am, dispatching multiple fire units to the Rasheedabad location as the emergency escalated.

The targeted structure was a two-storey commercial property operated as the Al-Hamad Plastic Factory, which specialized in producing decorative items and windowpanes. According to initial findings detailed by Rescue spokesperson Hassaanul Haseeb Khan, the blaze originated when the oil tanker caught fire and exploded during the fuel transfer, propelling burning oil across the factory grounds and onto surrounding streets and creating widespread panic.

Roughly 70 percent of the raging fire had been successfully contained by teams utilizing 11 fire tenders, which worked to prevent the flames from spreading further across the ground, first, and second floors. While the definitive trigger remains subject to a comprehensive forensic investigation regarding potential human error during refueling, the tanker itself was entirely incinerated in the accident.

Police officials alongside the Site-B police station confirmed that no injuries or fatalities resulted from the emergency. Sindh Rangers units were likewise deployed to the scene to assist rescue crews and regulate local traffic flow, as municipal authorities continue broader safety audits across commercial buildings throughout the city's seven districts.

stories.title: India Defeats Pakistan to Win Record Tenth SAFF Championship Title
stories.summary:
Pakistan's historic bid for a maiden SAFF Championship title ended in heartbreak on Tuesday at the National Stadium in Dhaka, where India secured a 2-1 comeback victory in the final. Late substitute Sandip Mandi scored the winning goal in the 87th minute, extending India's record to ten regional crowns and securing their third consecutive championship. The defeat was particularly cruel for Pakistan, who had dominated much of the match and held the lead through the first half.

Pakistan controlled the opening exchanges and maintained 65 percent possession in the first half compared to India's 35 percent, outshooting their opponents nine to four. Their dominance paid off in first-half stoppage time when Alamghir Ghazi curled a shot into the far corner past goalkeeper Yousuf Butt's efforts, giving Pakistan a 1-0 advantage at the interval. It was Ghazi's second goal of the tournament, with both of his strikes coming against India.

India increased their attacking pressure after the break. Pakistan's hopes suffered a major setback in the 57th minute when midfielder Junaid Shah received a red card following a VAR review for a rough challenge, leaving the Green-shirts with ten men. India capitalized almost immediately when Sohail Ahmed Butt scored his fourth goal of the tournament to equalize in the 58th minute. Despite being a man down, Pakistan maintained a resilient defensive shape.

The resilient defense held until the 87th minute, when Sandip Mandi found the net to put India ahead for the first time in the match. Pakistan pushed for a late equalizer but failed to break through, allowing India to hold on and claim the championship trophy once again.

stories.title: Post-Mortem Reveals Brutal Violence in Islamabad Domestic Worker's Death
stories.summary:
The post-mortem report of 13-year-old domestic worker Fatima Asghar revealed approximately 20 major wounds and visible marks of physical violence spanning from her head to her toes. Conducted by the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences, the examination documented severe physical trauma, untreated infections resulting in pus and foul odor, blood clots in the heart and kidneys, and burn marks consistent with a heated iron. Fatima was employed at the Islamabad residence of a senior Police Service of Pakistan officer posted in Gujranwala.

The girl's death on November 14 was initially reported as mysterious, and local police allegedly attempted to keep the matter quiet before senior officials intervened and a case was registered at the Shams Colony Police Station. Two suspects, Afshan—a Pakistani-origin Canadian national and wife of the police officer—and Qari Ali, a tutor and Punjab Highway Patrol employee, were arrested and granted a four-day physical remand by an Islamabad district court. During police interrogation, the suspects gave contradictory statements.

Afshan denied ever subjecting the minor to physical violence. However, Qari Ali claimed he beat Fatima on Afshan's instructions, adding that he complied out of fear of losing his job. Following these disclosures, police conducted a surprise raid at the officer's residence within the Police Lines Headquarters, recovering an iron on Afshan's identification and sticks and canes on Ali's identification. Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi stated that the police pursued the case despite initial reluctance from the victim's father and are conducting a thorough investigation.

The case has drawn widespread condemnation and calls for justice. First Lady Bibi Asifa Bhutto Zardari expressed deep sorrow over the incident, emphasizing that under Islamabad's four-year-old child employment law, no child of that age could be employed as a domestic worker. She called for a transparent, impartial investigation and strict enforcement of child protection laws to prevent further exploitation and abuse of vulnerable children in domestic settings.
